# Windows runtime notices

These unmodified upstream files accompany the MinGW-w64 Windows build.
The bundle builder copies the `.txt` files into its `licenses` directory.

- GCC 13: `COPYING3` and `COPYING.RUNTIME` from the
  [GCC release branch](https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/tree/releases/gcc-13).
- MinGW-w64 13.0.0: `COPYING`, `AUTHORS` and
  `COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime/COPYING.MinGW-w64-runtime.txt` from the
  [upstream release](https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64/tree/v13.0.0).
